purpose: Teach: 激変/奪取/過密/浸水/殿堂/リンチ/撃破/国力

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、革命期に社会が激変した事例を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you wrote your paper on social upheaval during revolutionary periods, didn't you?
lines.style: Observant, warm inquiry. Gentle opening. Steady pace, genuinely engaged. Not testing—inviting him to elaborate.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、領土奪取を巡る戦争史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—I focused on the history of territorial wars and their geopolitical shifts.
lines.style: Polite, slightly formal response. Careful enunciation on key terms. Modest but definite. No apology in the tone—just clarification.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、都市の過密問題を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: I see. And you addressed urban overcrowding in another piece, didn't you?
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before speaking. Recognition mixed with gentle curiosity. Warm but measured. Checking whether he's building a pattern.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、洪水で建物が浸水した事例の研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—I examined flooding events and their impact on urban infrastructure and displacement.
lines.style: Straightforward, no hedging. Matter-of-fact delivery on the technical details. Steady breath. Comfortable with the subject matter.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 音楽家が殿堂入りした事例を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Your paper on cultural institutions—that covered a musician's hall of fame induction, correct?
lines.style: Slightly lighter tone now. Warm recognition. Small smile in the voice. Still professional but less formal than before.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、人種を狙ったリンチの歴史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Actually, that paper examined the history of racially motivated violence and its systemic roots.
lines.style: Gentle but firm correction. No edge—just honest. Steady delivery despite the heavy subject. Respectful of what he's studying.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、近代戦における要塞撃破史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Right. And you also studied military history—fortress destruction during modern warfare?
lines.style: Reflective, slower tempo. Acknowledging the breadth of his work. Slight pause before continuing. Genuine interest in how he's thinking across disciplines.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、国力の指標研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—I researched national power indices and how military capacity is measured and compared historically.
lines.style: Confident, clear. Closes firmly but not abruptly. The 'yes' is grounded. Technical but human. Small exhale of completion.
